_doc: Phase-IP dispatch-precision regression baseline (caddy). THE GATE: a future oracle run on this corpus_sha must hold dispatch_precision >= gate.dispatch_precision_floor AND sound_sites >= gate.sound_sites_floor. A decrease is permitted ONLY as a deliberate, recorded decision -- paste the new oracle summary into the PR and explain the delta. recall_gap is reported, never gating. UPDATE 2026-06-16: the Slice-E baseline (0.9994, 1 prism_fp) was superseded by the arity-disambiguation fix -- the one prism_fp (headers_test.go:366) is RESOLVED, precision is now 1.0. Regenerate: see eval/README.md 'Dispatch oracle' + the eval/tools/dispatch_oracle.py module docstring.
prism: arity-disambiguation (commit 846a016 on branch phase-ip-arity-disambiguation; on top of PR-2 #97 + Slice-E #98). Supersedes the Slice-E baseline at prism 1f7330d/278dd70.

prism_fp_site.status: RESOLVED by arity-disambiguation: the 3-arg call now arity-filters the 2-arg HandlerFunc candidate -> fanout 0; recorded in eval/adjudications.jsonl.

key_finding: CaddyModule dispatch recall remains SOUND: every x.(Module).CaddyModule() site mints the 121-implementer RTA-live registry set, a subset of gopls's 132 satisfiers. The arity-disambiguation fix removed exactly the 1 prism_fp (manifest delta: only headers_test.go:366 changed, fanout 1->0; all 62 other dispatch sites byte-identical) -- a precision win with zero recall loss.

gate.rule: Future runs on this corpus_sha hold dispatch_precision == 1.0 and sound >= 61 unless a decrease is recorded with rationale in the PR. A drop in dispatch-site count or a site falling to fanout 0 is a recall regression -- check the manifest delta, not just over_approx. Across-corpus-drift comparison re-anchors verdicts by site_fingerprint.
